snippet.title: Flappy Bird for MSX
snippet.description: This is my version of [dot]GEARS's Flappy Bird for MSX computers. This game runs in a simple MSX1 computer with at least 32KiB of RAM (or only 8KiB if stored in a ROM cartridge). The source code is released in GNU/GPL and you are invited to run, learn, share and modify! -- https://github.com/plainspooky/flappybird4msx
